description: Classify a discovered (or manually added) competitor candidate. 'direct' seeds a BrandCompetitor row; 'similar' and 'not_relevant' update the probe JSON only. Call once per domain. Probe must be in completed state first. Returns { candidates } — the updated full candidate list.

classification.description: 'direct' = head-to-head competitor (adds to tracked list); 'similar' = adjacent market; 'not_relevant' = not a competitor.

name.description: Optional human-readable name for the competitor (used when adding manually).

name: competitor_probe_classify
